description: Captures a complete deterministic E1 (shareware) run from spawn through E1M9 to the finale, recording per-tic state hashes (02-012) and per-second framebuffer hashes (02-011) across the entire route. This is the master end-to-end oracle that downstream side-by-side comparison tests use to validate the TS engine against vanilla. Entries empty pending external reference run.
captureMethod: Drive a scripted full-clear E1 route (E1M1 through E1M8 then E1M9 secret then back to E1M9 exit then finale) under deterministic input injection; capture state every tic (full 35 Hz resolution) and framebuffer every 35 tics; record music events on each level transition.
